name: Jael
summary: The wife of Heber the Kenite. When Sisera, captain of Jabin's army, fled to her tent, she killed him with a tent nail, and the song of Deborah and Barak called her blessed above women.

key_moments.title: Invites Sisera into Her Tent
key_moments.description: Sisera fled on foot to Jael's tent, because Heber's house was at peace with Jabin. Jael told him to turn in and not fear, covered him, and gave him milk when he asked for water.

key_moments.title: Drives a Tent Nail Through Sisera
key_moments.description: While Sisera lay fast asleep, Jael took a tent nail and a hammer, went softly to him, and drove the nail through his temples into the ground. So he died.

key_moments.title: Shows Barak the Man He Seeks
key_moments.description: As Barak came chasing Sisera, Jael went out to meet him and said she would show him the man he was looking for. In her tent Sisera lay dead with the nail in his temples.

key_moments.title: Called Blessed Above Women
key_moments.description: In the song of victory, Jael was called blessed above women in the tent. The song told how she gave Sisera milk, then struck him with the hammer, and he fell dead at her feet.
